findings.quoted_line: title: The higher AADL Priority value shall be the higher priority in every fixed-priority analysis
findings.claim: Marked implemented for 'every fixed-priority analysis', but spar-codegen proof_gen.rs still orders the Lean RTA higher-priority set by period only, ignoring Priority; `spar codegen` theorems disagree with `spar analyze` rta on any model where Priority overrides RM.
The test writes .aadl files into a per-PID temp directory and never removes it; every test run (one PID per test under nextest) leaves a spar-rta-prio-<pid> directory behind in the system temp dir.
